name: Rodolfo Kusch
shortBio: Argentine philosopher and anthropologist of América profunda who contrasted European ontology of mastery (ser) with Indigenous and popular American grounded dwelling (estar).
centralQuestion: What happens to ontology when we begin not from European "being someone" (ser), but from Indigenous American "being-here in the cosmos" (estar)?

keyWorks.title: América profunda
keyWorks.description: Contrasts Western technological ser with Andean Indigenous estar as foundational polarity of American thought.

keyWorks.title: Indigenous and Popular Thinking in América
keyWorks.description: Phenomenological investigation of Quechua-Aymara symbolic reason and popular Latin American philosophy.
